name: cli-session-coordinator
body: The session coordinator: the live server that owns the worktree's `apg/.trans/db.lbug` and the extended `apg/.trans/specs.lock` for its life, binds the session socket, and admits durable node/edge mutations in receive order. Admission validates each change against the live database the coordinator holds open and applies it as a delta touching only the affected nodes and edges, reading and writing no `apg/layers/**` node file and no `graph.jsonl`. The coordinator holds the pending node-file writes and deletes and flushes them at a save as one atomic write plus one commit.
